reports.quote: Korea-based CGT CDMO with end-to-end cell and gene therapy manufacturing capabilities. Operates the only hospital-based GMP facility in Korea, enabling integrated autologous cell therapy production. Expanding into high-margin Japanese regenerative medicine and aesthetics markets. Key pipeline: EN001 for Charcot-Marie-Tooth (CMT) disease entering Phase 2a; potential conditional approval could accelerate commercialization
